company.name: Haber
company.shortDescription: Haber is an integrated platform for process, utilities and water systems driving visibility.
company.description:
At Haber, we drive the future of industrial automation. With a focus on manufacturing industry, our portfolio includes automation services for chemical dosing across different applications at paper mills, sugar mills, distilleries, breweries, independent institutions, and mining.

Haber was established on February 28, 2017 by Vipin Raghavan and Priya Venkat in Maharashtra, India.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based AI-driven platform for real-time monitoring, control, and automation of process, utilities, and water systems in industrial plants.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven advanced planning and scheduling system that optimizes deckle matching to reduce trim loss and improve production efficiency in paper mills.
productsAndServices.name: Kaiznn™ Deckle Matching Software

productsAndServices.description: An automated sampling system that replaces manual sampling to provide accurate, real-time process monitoring data.
productsAndServices.name: Robotic Sampling System

productsAndServices.description: A program that optimizes moisture content in lime mud to reduce fuel consumption and improve lime kiln operations in pulp mills.
productsAndServices.name: Lime Mud Dewatering Program

productsAndServices.description: AI-driven solutions for optimizing cooling tower and boiler operations to improve asset integrity and reduce water, energy, and chemical usage.
productsAndServices.name: Utilities Process Optimization Solutions
